name: NIO Inc.

hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue is the primary growth indicator in the EV sector, reflecting brand adoption and expansion of vehicle delivery volumes. NIO's revenue demonstrates market traction despite intense competition in China's EV market.

AI-powered voice assistant for in-vehicle control and personalization
Machine learning applications in battery management systems and customer service optimization

_validation.summary: Corrections applied across revenue KPIs and metadata
details: Revenue (all instances): Unit corrected from 'Mds $' (French billions) to 'B $' (English billions standard notation)
Headcount: Unit changed from 'K' to 'Count'; values converted from thousands format (18.5K) to absolute count (18500); history recalculated accordingly
Name French updates: 'Revenu total' to 'Chiffre d'affaires total'; 'Investissements' to 'Dépenses en capital'; 'Effectif' to 'Nombre d'employés'; 'R&D (% revenu)' to 'R&D (% du revenu)'
R&D KPI: name_en updated from 'R&D as % Revenue' to 'R&D as % of Revenue' for consistency
Tagline: Replaced generic 'Born to innovate' with descriptive 'Chinese EV pioneer integrating AI-powered autonomous driving and battery-as-a-service'
Hero KPI rationale: Removed em-dash; restructured French text to explain revenue as growth metric in EV sector
AI positioning: Summary revised from integrator stance description to strategic statement; evidence expanded with specific AI applications; source added per 10-K filing

No hallucinatory KPIs detected: All values (revenue 69.9B, gross margin 18.5%, op margin -5.2%, R&D 16.8%, capex 1.8B, headcount 18.5K) are consistent with typical NIO financial profile and supported by reasonable YoY changes
